name: Reagent bank: deposit and withdraw reagents, keep bound reagents out of the account bank
contract: With mod-reagent-bank-account at its defaults (ReagentBankAccount.Enable=1, AccountWide=1), .rbank deposit all
moves every storable trade good from the bags into the server-side bank and .rbank withdraw all returns
them. Primal Nether (23572) binds on pickup; an account-wide bank would hand it to other characters, so
neither deposit all nor a targeted .rbank deposit item takes it, while unbound Linen Cloth (2589) moves.
After a relog the deposit is still in the bank and not back in the bags. The addon's interface is not
exercised; this checks the command protocol it drives.

steps.label: Deposit all leaves the bound Primal Nether in the bags
A targeted deposit refuses the bound Primal Nether
After a relog the deposited cloth is not back in the bags
Withdraw all returns the deposited cloth
